description: Safe local CLI and MCP for the Viral View public API

tools.name: account_balance
tools.description: Read available generation-provider credits. Returns the Balance.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Check generation-provider reachability. Returns the ProviderStatus.

tools.name: account_usage
tools.description: List recent generation and export usage. Optional: limit (default: 25). Returns array of UsageEvent.

tools.name: library_get
tools.description: Load one approved source ad. Required: id. Returns the APIResponse.

tools.name: library_search
tools.description: Search the approved Ad Library. Optional: query, style, limit (default: 12) (plus 1 more). Returns array of LibraryItem.

params.name: query
params.description: Words to match in the ad library

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor from a prior library search

tools.name: product_scan
tools.description: Extract editable product facts from a public product URL. Required: url. Returns the new APIResponse.

tools.name: projects_get
tools.description: Load one owned project. Required: id. Returns the APIResponse.

tools.name: projects_list
tools.description: List owned projects. Returns array of Project.

tools.name: task_status_export_status
tools.description: Poll an existing export job. Required: job-id. Returns the JobStatus.

tools.name: task_status_extraction_status
tools.description: Poll an existing source-link extraction job. Required: job-id. Returns the JobStatus.

tools.name: task_status_image_status
tools.description: Poll an existing paid image job without spending again. Required: task-id. Optional: source-image-url. Returns the JobStatus.

params.name: source-image-url
params.description: Optional source image URL used to recover task state
